readOnlyReview.clearGate: Director waits for remainingToSpawn=0,no living targets and no pending splitAt child promises; tested actual delayed children before clear.
readOnlyReview.population: Reservations count living fission parents at net future cost2 and dead pending landing slots,then share the host maxActors24; real materialization reaches24 without stealing primary slots.
readOnlyReview.pause: Session pauses after a clear; combat and later protocol choices use public APIs,elapsed/phaseUntil stay frozen while paused,and next warning waits through the resumed intermission. The sampled run opens sequential pauses rather than simultaneous modals.
readOnlyReview.death: Session checks failure before endless afterInput; director rejects dead player/tissue state. Natural death,post-result no-op and terminal empty-wave ordering pass.
readOnlyReview.elite: Battle reserves a three-telegraph slot before committing; frozen aim and body are unchanged while that same pending commitment remains; direct knockback/death/resolution may legitimately end it.
readOnlyReview.birth: Current director uses420-600 world ring,minimum340 distance,geometry/bounds/body gap checks. Central setup and12-wave seed71 complete without bot progress timeout.
readOnlyReview.pathLimit: Enemy direct pursuit plus fixed tangent fallback is not complete pathfinding. The bot navigates around visible obstacles and may approach stalled enemies; this single natural run does not prove every seed/corner or indefinite enemy reachability.
